contents.DefaultText:
Hello everyone!

What a day!
It started good, then turned into a bit of a roller coaster, then crashed and burned!
We didn't expect that wave of negative reviews from China and it has affected us quite a bit.
At the current rate, if things don't change we'll probably be reaching a negative reception rating this Saturday. I suspect we may even reach a record in negative reviews!
We're still alive and working though! And, on the bright side, for what's worth our reception in the rest of the world is sitting at good 91% approval rating!
contents.Text:
大家好！

真是难以想象的一天！
一开始一切都很好，然后变成了过山车，最后一落千丈！
我们没有想到这次来自中国的差评潮，这对我们影响很大。
按照目前的速度，如果情况没有改变，我们本周六的评价比可能会达到负数。我猜测我们的差评甚至可能达到历史新高！
不过，我们还活着，还在努力！而且，从好的方面来看，我们在世界其他地方的好评率高达 91%！

contents.ja:
Hello everyone!

What a day!
It started good, then turned into a bit of a roller coaster, then crashed and burned!
We didn't expect that wave of negative reviews from China and it has affected us quite a bit.
At the current rate, if things don't change we'll probably be reaching a negative reception rating this Saturday. I suspect we may even reach a record in negative reviews!
We're still alive and working though! And, on the bright side, for what's worth our reception in the rest of the world is sitting at good 91% approval rating!

contents.DefaultText:
There's a combination of factors that lead to this situation, one is that our Chinese community had joined Tropical Island as it was just out of Early Access, and we think they didn't have a measure of the progress that our games go through from EA to release.

We know Fantasy Forest is still far from finished, and that it's far from the goals and ambitions we have for it. But we also know that it already has more content than Tropical Island did when it first came out in Early Access, and having played the game for hundreds of hours, we trust in our vision. To those of you who might be harbouring doubts, we would like to ask that you have faith in us. We will continue to work hard and iterate, and with the feedback of the community we can really make the game a lot better than its predecessor.

This is how we work, we start small, and then grow from there.

Your feedback is very valuable, but sending it to us in the form of a negative review can really be detrimental to the future of the game. With us being a small team and the game having a relatively small audience, every negative review has a lot of impact, including on us as individuals. If you want to let us know what you think, please consider doing it through our Discord server, the Steam forums, the QQ group or our personal email. Of course you are free to leave a review if you didn't enjoy the game, but please keep in mind that these alternatives exist if you want to communicate your feedback to us.

As it stands, we have been greatly affected by this wave of negative reviews from our Chinese playerbase, so if you like our game and think our project is worth it but have yet to leave a review, please consider doing so. It would greatly help us retain some visibility on Steam during these important days after the release.

And to those of you who have written positive reviews, thank you for your support, we're very happy that you like the game, you really keep us going. :)

Speaking of feedback, we wanted to address some of the main recurring themes that we found in the reviews:
contents.Text:
导致这种情况的因素有很多，其中一个原因是我们的中国社区在《热带岛屿》刚结束抢先体验版时才加入其中，我们认为他们没有衡量我们的游戏从抢先体验到正式发布的进度。

我们知道《奇幻森林》还远未完成，也远未达到我们的目标和抱负。但我们也知道，它已经比《热带岛屿》在抢先体验版中首次推出时的内容更多了，而且在玩了数百个小时的游戏后，我们相信我们的愿景。对于那些可能心存疑虑的人，我们希望你们对我们充满信心。我们将继续努力工作并不断迭代，在社区的反馈下，我们真的可以让这款游戏比它的前身好很多。

这就是我们的工作方式，我们从小处做起，然后从那里成长。

您的反馈非常有价值，但以差评的形式传达给我们可能会对游戏的未来产生不利影响。我们是一个小团队，游戏的受众也相对较少，所以每一条差评都会对我们个人产生很大影响。如果您想让我们知道您的想法，请考虑通过我们的 Discord 服务器、Steam 论坛、QQ 群或我们的个人电子邮件来告诉我们。当然，如果您不喜欢这款游戏，您可以自由地留下评论，但请记得，如果您想向我们传达您的反馈，还有其他除差评外的选择。

目前，我们受到中国玩家群体的这波负面评论的极大影响，所以如果您喜欢我们的游戏并认为我们的项目值得，但尚未留下评论，请考虑这样做。这将极大地帮助我们在发布后的这些重要日子里在 Steam 上保持一定的知名度。

对于那些写过好评的人，感谢您的支持，我们很高兴您喜欢这款游戏，您真的让我们继续前进。:)

说到反馈，我们想谈谈我们在评论中发现的一些主要反复出现的主题：

contents.DefaultText: - Getting lost in the woods... I understand that many of you don't like this, so we'll be working on some features to alleviate some of those concerns, including drawing more art for the locations. - Food rots too fast! We hear you! This is something we've been tweaking again and again, but perception is that things are still rotting too fast. This has been fixed as of now. - Quests vs Freedom! We understand some players perceive that quests are too constraining. We will be working on releasing a quest-less mode soon for those of you who want it. In the meantime, if you really dislike quests, you can also equip the "All Knowing" perk, which should unlock all blueprints from the start. - The game is not finished enough: Unfortunately there's not much I can say about this one. We are going to be working hard on adding more content, but know that there is already a large amount of new things to experience in Fantasy Forest. The game has enough content for dozens of hours and you should definitely try to survive winter and try the magic system.
contents.Text: - 在森林里迷路... 我明白你们不喜欢这样，所以我们将致力于开发一些功能来缓解其中的一些担忧，包括为这些地点绘制更多艺术作品。 - 食物腐烂得太快了！ 我们听到了你们的声音！这是其中一件我们来回调整的事情，但人们认为东西仍然腐烂得太快了。目前这个问题已经解决了。 - 任务对自由！ 我们明白一些玩家认为任务太过束缚。 我们将很快为那些想要的人发布一个无任务模式。与此同时，如果你真的不喜欢任务，你也可以装备“全知”技能，这应该会从一开始就解锁所有蓝图。 - 游戏还不够完整： 不幸的是，关于这个我没什么可说的。 我们会努力添加更多内容，但要知道幻想森林中已经有大量新内容可供体验。游戏内容足够玩几十个小时，你一定要尝试活过冬天并尝试魔法系统。

contents.DefaultText: We have just pushed a new patch with some nice new additions that we believe should address some of the issues mentioned before. - Tutorial Skipping: The tutorial can now be skipped when starting a new game. This should unlock all basic blueprints, unlock the first branching quests and make you start directly in the river clearing. - Rot Nerf: We have substantially increased the time carcasses, meats, mushrooms and nettle leaves take to rot. - Fishing Buff: It should now be easier to catch fish in Summer. Both in terms of chances and fish variety. - Help Screens: We've added 3 help screens to help players learn the basics of the UI and well as many tips on how to get the most of the advanced interface features.
contents.Text: 我们刚刚发布了一个新补丁，其中包含一些不错的新内容，我们认为这些内容应该可以解决之前提到的一些问题。 - 跳过教程： 现在可以在开始新游戏时跳过教程。这应该可以解锁所有基本蓝图，解锁第一个分支任务，并让您直接从河畔林荫处开始。 - 腐烂削弱： 我们大大增加了尸体、肉类、蘑菇和荨麻叶腐烂所需的时间。 - 钓鱼增强： 现在在夏天捕鱼应该更容易了。无论是概率还是鱼类种类。 - 帮助屏幕： 我们添加了 3 个帮助屏幕，以帮助玩家学习更多 UI 相关的的基础知识以及如何充分利用高级界面功能的许多技巧。

contents.DefaultText:
- Added help screens.
- Added the possibility to skip the tutorial.
- Improved Chop Wood subquest text to make it less confusing.
- Eat actions no longer costs any stamina.
- Boiled Moss is now shown in the food filter.
- Improvised Bed now drops the materials it was made from.
- Deconstructing an Improvised Shelter no longer destroys its inventory contents.
- Increased Fish variety and doubled catch rates of Fish in Summer.
- Significantly increased the amount of time carcasses, meat, forest caps and nettle leaves need to rot.


That is all for now.
See you in the next announcement!
